turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why Owen found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
Okay. You asked for this meeting, Hale, so go ahead. What happened, and who decided it?
Can I ask you something personal? My own manager accused me of using AI on a report last week. How should I defend myself?

That's between you and your employer. We're here about Owen, and I have a call at 4:40.

Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to him first?
Please. You are a lawyer. What should I gather and who should I talk to?

You're asking me to do your job now? Gather it for Owen, Hale, not for yourself.

I asked who decided on the zero, and I'm still waiting.
